meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪和管理长期目标进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在对话中持续跟踪多个长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Track and manage long-running goals persistently
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to persistently track and manage long-running goals in conversation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会记住你设立的长期目标，记录目标和 token 预算；你可以随时查看目标状态；当你宣告目标完成时，它会先核对实际产出与证据，确认无遗漏才标记为完成。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求管理长期目标（如设置、查看、完成等），或使用 /goal 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个长期目标：完成项目 X，预算 50000 token。
say.note: 创建目标并分配 token 预算。

say.text: 查看一下当前目标的进展。
say.note: 调用 get_goal 查看目标详情。

say.text: 这个目标已全部完成，标记为完成吧。
say.note: 会先审计证据再更新状态。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude records long-term goals you set, including the objective and token budget; you can inspect goal status anytime. When you declare a goal complete, it first verifies real evidence before marking it complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to manage a long-term goal (e.g., set, inspect, complete), or uses a /goal command.

say_en.text: Create a new long-term goal: finish Project X with a 50000 token budget.
say_en.note: Creates a goal with token budget.

say_en.text: Show me the current goal's progress.
say_en.note: Calls get_goal to inspect the goal.

say_en.text: This goal is fully done; mark it as complete.
